caption:
Koko pushes a full wheelbarrow around the garden every weekend, and lately her back aches after every run.

Piling the load near the handles means you lift and steady more of the weight, so your back may have to work harder. Loading over the wheel lets the wheel carry more of it.

Hybi's tip: load over the wheel, use half loads and more trips, lift with bent knees, and turn with your feet rather than twisting.

Pain spreading down your leg, numbness or weakness, or back pain at night are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio
